physical_model.change_summary: Measured battery envelope/mass and its tray, plus the shallow mobile-power carrier with short-end USB access.
physical_model.verification_scope: Saved simulator outputs rechecked using CPU; fixed query points, registered bodies and protected properties only.

limitations: Each result is one fixed-seed simulation evaluation; hardware deployment is not approved.
No independent motion-metric recomputation from raw NPZ was performed for this report. Original JSON bytes, evidence hashes and cross references were verified.
Maximum XY phase/time is absent from the acquired wave summary; endpoint position cannot establish the maximum.
Model exposure h is a simulated load state, not measured motor temperature. Causation of return failure is not established.
Preview holds are presentation only. The second prone cycle and complete wave/sit cycles are not visible in the14-second montage.
All18 original recordings were verified on the execution machine; only two full originals and both completed digests were copied locally. Model backup remains deferred.
SHA values identify private evidence; this selected publication is not a self-contained reproduction package.
publication_scope: Selected newly written measurements and two authorized MP4/GIF pairs. No model weights, raw measurements, logs, private images or connection data.
